paragraphs.text: Sekki (SEK-kee) , Seasons’ Guide , is a kami of Kamigawa .

Sekki is the great kami of the turning of the seasons. It is a colossal Kami made up of eight intertwined smaller kami. This huge kami is a manifestation of nature's adaptability. When in danger, the kami can separate into its 8 smaller kami, which can then later re-form the larger kami.
